text:
Maya (CS): Heads-up from today's onboarding + renewal check-ins. Dropping three customer asks that need product triage — two are blocking pilots or flagged as renewal risk.

Maya (CS): 1) Brightline Health: requirement for environment-scoped API keys (dev/stage/prod) + per-environment audit logs for compliance. Legal insists on separation. Deadline: EOW for pilot.

Maya (CS): 2) NovaRetail: asks for per-route on/off toggle and simple caps. They hit an unexpected pilot bill (~$80k ARR pilot), want immediate control to prevent overages during promos.

Maya (CS): 3) SummitHealth: needs an in-console onboarding checklist, starter prompt templates and a short guided walkthrough to get Ops to use embeddings search — adoption stalled ~30%.

Lina (PM): Please add estimated impact ($ at risk or % adoption) and an acceptance-criteria line for each so we can split MVP vs follow-up.

Maya (CS): Done in the shared sheet (link): Brightline = legal block (high), NovaRetail = ~$80k at risk (high), Summit = adoption lag (med). Acceptance criteria samples included.

Alex (SRE): Note: native per-route quota in runtime is not trivial. Short-term mitigation: enforce toggle/caps at edge proxy quickly; longer-term: runtime counters.

Alex (SRE): Quick proxy sketch:
```
proxy.rules:
  - route: /v1/generate/*
    hard_toggle: true
    soft_quota_per_min: 1000
```

Sam (Product): NovaRetail: propose ship a feature-flagged UI toggle as MVP (2 sprints) + runtime quota later.

Diego (AE): Brightline legal gave a hard date. If we miss env-key scoping we risk pausing the pilot and the renewal. Can we prioritize?

Lina (PM): Agreed. Re-prioritizing: Brightline env-keys = P0 (legal). NovaRetail toggle = P0/P1 depending on proxy mitigation. Summit templates = P2 (docs + quick templates possible asap).

triage-bot: Created tickets RDW-4321 (env-key-scoping) and RDW-4322 (route-toggle-proxy-mitigation). https://redwood.jira/RDW-4321 https://redwood.jira/RDW-4322

Maya (CS): Owners: Lina -> RDW-4321, Alex -> RDW-4322, Sam -> Summit onboarding templates.

Lina (PM): I'll draft acceptance criteria for RDW-4321 tonight: env-tagged keys, KMS rotation integration, per-env audit-log export, API to list keys by environment. Call out anything infeasible.

Alex (SRE): KMS + per-env logs will touch infra work. I'll scope proxy POC by Fri EOD and add a runtime design story for planning.

Diego (AE): I'll escalate with Brightline legal to request a short extension if needed; flagging renewal rep.

Maya (CS): Please confirm ETA for RDW-4321 on this thread so Brightline has a date.

Sam (Product): Scheduling 30m sync for RDW-4321 tomorrow; will tag eng.

Maya (CS): If we ship proxy toggle, add UI note: "temporary mitigation — not billing-accurate". NovaRetail needs the toggle ASAP even if imperfect.

Lina (PM): Will update sheet and move RDW-4321 to in-progress after design sync.

Maya (CS): Quick follow-ups: Maya -> Brightline legal Thu 10:00; Alex -> proxy POC by Fri EOD; Lina -> acceptance criteria + sync tomorrow; Sam -> onboarding templates draft by next Tue. Thanks all :raised_hands:
